notes: Address the user formally as “আপনি” with polite imperatives (করুন, দেখুন, বেছে নিন). Standard colloquial (চলিত) Bengali, not সাধু. Buttons are short actions in polite imperative (“সংরক্ষণ করুন”, “মুছুন”); simple dismiss/cancel buttons may be bare nouns (“বাতিল”). Labels and headings are nouns. Bengali has no capital letters. End full sentences with the দাঁড়ি (।), keep ? and ! as is; keep the em dash (—) where English uses it; short labels and toasts without a full stop in English get none. Use curly double quotes “ ” for quoted UI/option names. Numbers stay in Western digits (placeholders insert Western digits). Established loanwords are written in Bengali script (ডিজাইন, অ্যাকাউন্ট, সাইন ইন, লিংক, ফন্ট, আপলোড, PDF); option names on Lulu's English-only site and in English print dialogs stay in English, with a Bengali gloss in parentheses where helpful. Interior (of a printed book) = “ভেতরের পৃষ্ঠা”.
